verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own event-driven mechanisms. Transformations run custom JavaScript or Python on every event in flight to filter, enrich or reshape it before delivery. Tracking Plans let you set predefined rules that catch and act on non-compliant events, and the compliance toolkit blocks, masks or encrypts PII before it goes downstream. These are rule-like actions triggered by events, but they are limited to processing data in the pipeline and are not a general rule engine. Missing for 10: a declarative if-event-then-action rule builder for arbitrary downstream actions, any AI-assisted rule authoring tied to automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rule-triggered actions.
